prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Practice calling, hiding, and chatting with your pet right on your screen before finishing setup.", "Try Pet Controls", "Press Alt+P anytime to summon or hide your pet on your desktop."]
1: ["Preview Your Custom Pet", "Check your pet's generated look. If it looks off, refine your photo or try a different style.", "Looks Great, Adopt!"]
2: []
3: ["Choose Your Pet Experience", "Pick a ready-to-adopt companion or create a unique custom pet from your own photos.", "Continue to Selection", "Path Overview"]
4: ["Sign in with your original account method to keep existing pets and progress intact."]
5: ["Ensure your desktop display permissions are enabled while we prepare your pet frame.", "Tip: If your pet does not appear on screen, check your taskbar tray icon."]
6: ["Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "Use Alt+P to hide/show, click and drag to move, or right-click for quick pet interactions.", "Launch to Desktop"]
7: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Use clear, well-lit photos facing forward for best 3D pet generation results.", "Photo Quality Checklist"]
8: ["Presets adopt instantly in 30 seconds! Custom pets take under 2 minutes.", "Instant Desktop Spawn"]
9: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion...", "Feel free to minimize this window. We will alert you the moment your pet lands on your desktop."]
